decision_rule: A filter is declared to show lift ONLY IF its mean R exceeds the 95th percentile of ALL THREE nulls (A offset-preserving level, B day-shuffled level, C direction-frequency-matched), each from 200 draws. Failing any null = no lift. Null C is decisive: passing A and B while failing C means the filter captured directional drift, not level information. Fewer than 100 sessions = descriptive only, no verdict.
f3_status: F3 is a session-level base rate, reported for pipeline validation only. It is not part of the lift hypotheses.

hypotheses.F1_golden_rule: Taking the direction implied by price vs the previous-day POC at 09:30 produces positive mean R.
hypotheses.F2_midnight_open: Taking the direction implied by price vs the 00:00 ET open at 09:30 produces positive mean R.

primary_statistic: mean R of the filter-directed session population
